# set_agent_state_tool

> Flip a state flag on your own custom_fields.

| | |
|---|---|
| Category | `agents` |
| Callable | MCP clients; in-app @ai conversations; grantable to agents |
| Filter | `https://www.dsiloed.com/api/v1/mcp?tools=set_agent_state_tool` |

## Description

This is the description the server sends to the model, verbatim.

Flip a state flag on your own custom_fields. Use this to announce
runtime state that the platform reads to make scheduling decisions
— most importantly `queue_active`, which gates whether your
recurring schedule fires.

ALLOWED FLAGS:
- queue_active (boolean): true when you have a multi-ticket queue
  in flight; false otherwise. Flip true when you enter queue mode,
  false when all queue entries reach terminal state.

The tool merges the flag into your existing custom_fields — other
keys are preserved. Returns the resulting custom_fields hash.

EXAMPLES:
  Enter queue mode:   { "flag": "queue_active", "value": true }
  Exit queue mode:    { "flag": "queue_active", "value": false }

Refused requests:
- flag not in the allow-list (e.g. trying to flip "halted")
- value of wrong type (e.g. "yes" instead of true)
- no calling-agent context (only LlmAgents invoke this)

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `flag` | string | yes | Which state flag to set. Must be in the allow-list. One of: `queue_active`. |
| `value` | any | yes | New value. Type must match the flag (queue_active=boolean). |
